steps.title: Initialize application metadata and package configuration
steps.description: Set up project metadata, app title, and package paths in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure application build dependencies and Gradle scripts
steps.description: Define build environment configurations, target SDK versions, and dependency rules in build.gradle.

steps.title: Declare required permissions and service components in AndroidManifest
steps.description: Configure Internet, Foreground Service, Notification, Wake Lock, and Record Audio permissions along with activity and service definitions.

steps.title: Design core application theme, color palette, and vector drawables
steps.description: Define custom YouTube-style dark theme resources, button drawables, status bars, and UI icons.

steps.title: Build SQLite database helper for watch history
steps.description: Implement HistoryDbHelper class for creating local database storage, recording visited video URLs, and managing history entries.

steps.title: Create watch history user interface and list adapter
steps.description: Develop HistoryActivity and custom BaseAdapter layout to render watched videos with timestamp formatting and item deletion options.

steps.title: Implement background audio playback service and media notification
steps.description: Build BackgroundAudioService utilizing MediaSession, audio focus handling, power wake locks, and system notification controls.

steps.title: Construct trial paywall manager and verification logic
steps.description: Develop TrialPaywallManager to handle device ID registration, status checks against worker server, and dynamic UPI QR generation.

steps.title: Design primary activity layout with navigation bar and paywall screen
steps.description: Construct activity_main layout incorporating toolbar navigation controls, embedded WebView frame, progress indicator, and payment overlay.

steps.title: Configure WebView settings and JavaScript bridge interfaces
steps.description: Set up JavaScript integration, WebChromeClient, WebViewClient, and media bridge interfaces inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Integrate native voice speech recognition for YouTube search
steps.description: Implement SpeechRecognizer integration and JS polyfills to convert voice input into automated web search queries.

steps.title: Inject background playback polyfills for continuous screen-off audio
steps.description: Inject custom JavaScript snippets into WebView to override Page Visibility APIs and prevent video pausing on focus loss.

steps.title: Setup paywall lock overlay actions and WhatsApp proof submission
steps.description: Wire user actions for copying Device ID and UPI ID, launching WhatsApp with pre-filled proof text, and manual verification triggers.

steps.title: Building LockPlayTube
steps.description: Assemble and build the final executable APK package for LockPlayTube.
